mapper.select: SELECT pr.id AS id , pr.useremail AS userEmail , u.nickname AS nickname , pr.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , pr.rating AS rating , pr.content AS content , pr.created_at AS createdAt , pr.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM place_review pr LEFT JOIN users u ON pr.useremail = u.useremail LEFT JOIN place p ON pr.place_id = p.place_id WHERE pr.useremail = #{userEmail} ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC

SELECT pr.id AS id , pr.useremail AS userEmail , u.nickname AS nickname , pr.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , pr.rating AS rating , pr.content AS content , pr.created_at AS createdAt , pr.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM place_review pr LEFT JOIN users u ON pr.useremail = u.useremail LEFT JOIN place p ON pr.place_id = p.place_id WHERE pr.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
SELECT pr.place_id AS placeId , COALESCE(AVG(pr.rating), 0) AS averageRating , COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM place_review pr WHERE pr.place_id = #{placeId} GROUP BY pr.place_id
